title: The Twelve, the Three, and the One

blocks.text: Jesus chose twelve to live with Him and sent them out to preach, to heal, and to cast out evil spirits - {{mk 3:13,mk 3:14,mk 3:15|Mark 3:13-15}}. They were chosen as His ambassadors because of who they had become:

items: They were of humble character - gentle, truthful, prayerful, and holy within and without.
Their only ambition was to please their Captain - {{2tm 2:4|2 Timothy 2:4}}.
Whatever they did, they did as He would - proximity to Christ shaped their character - {{jo 2:6|John 2:6}}.
Anyone who encountered them could tell they had been with Jesus - {{act 4:13|Acts 4:13}}.

blocks.text: From among the twelve, Peter, James, and John were repeatedly chosen to accompany Jesus on particular occasions - {{mk 9:2,mk 9:3,mk 9:4,mk 9:5,mk 9:6,mk 9:7,mk 9:8,mk 9:9|Mark 9:2-9}}; {{mk 5:37|Mark 5:37}}; {{mt 17:1,mt 17:2,mt 17:3,mt 17:4,mt 17:5,mt 17:6,mt 17:7,mt 17:8,mt 17:9|Matthew 17:1-9}}; {{mt 26:36,mt 26:37,mt 26:38|Matthew 26:36-38}}.
And of the three, John, "the beloved", was given the closest place to the Master - {{jo 20:2|John 20:2}}; {{jo 21:7|John 21:7}}.
